title: Constructible lattices lift to locally free rational-heart objects
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme, without separatedness [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] set $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(R/t^n)_X$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and $A_X=B_X[1/t]$, the sheafification of sectionwise localization. Use ordinary module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,R)$ for the integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], $Q_X:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal R_X=D^b_c(X,E)$ for raw rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and $F_X:D(B_X)\to D(A_X)$ for $K\mapsto A_X\otimes^L_{B_X}K$. Write $J_X(Q_XK)=F_XK$, $J_X(u\otimes a)=aF_X(u)$ for the induced functor. A lisse rational object means an object of the standard heart [def-weil-constructible-heart] pro-etale locally isomorphic to a finite sum of coefficient units [def-real-rational-lisse-heart]. A finite locally free module sheaf means one pro-etale locally isomorphic to $A_X^{\oplus r}$, allowing rank zero and varying finite ranks.

Let $L$ be a finite locally free $A_X$-module sheaf. There exist a constructible $B_X$-module sheaf $N$, an isomorphism $\alpha:A_X\otimes_{B_X}N\xrightarrow{\sim}L$, a covering family of quasi-compact etale charts $u_i:Y_i\to X$, finite locally free $B_{Y_i}$-module sheaves $M_i$, and isomorphisms $\beta_i:A_{Y_i}\otimes_{B_{Y_i}}M_i\xrightarrow{\sim}L|_{Y_i}$. Here constructible for $N$ means that on each stratum of a finite locally closed stratification it is pro-etale locally $B\otimes_R V$ with $V$ a finitely presented $R$-module. Both $N[0]$ and $M_i[0]$ belong to the appropriate integral constructible categories, and $Q_X(N[0])$ lies in the standard heart.

For every choice of such $N,\alpha,(Y_i,M_i,\beta_i)$, the specified sheaf isomorphism $\beta_i^{-1}\alpha|_{Y_i}$ lifts uniquely to an isomorphism
$$Q_{Y_i}(N|_{Y_i}[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_{Y_i}(M_i[0])$$
whose image under $J_{Y_i}$ is that sheaf isomorphism in degree zero. The inverse has the corresponding inverse image under $J_{Y_i}$. Consequently $Q_X(N[0])$ is rationally lisse. This assertion imposes no globally locally free integral lattice on $L$.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, Proposition 6.8.4(6), Proposition 6.8.11(3); rationalized lattice lifting in Proposition 6.8.14(2)

proof.text: Use [lem-tw-lisse-lattice-normalized-realizations] to obtain normalized realizations, and [lem-tw-lisse-lattice-choice-existence] to obtain global constructible and quasi-compact etale-local free lattice choices for each L.
For any chosen c, apply [lem-tw-lisse-lattice-single-comparisons] to get integral membership of all three kinds of single complexes and invertibility of their specified comparison maps.

A single complex has no cohomology outside degree zero. Choose that same integral object and the identity isomorphism in both rational standard classes; this proves the rational heart property directly.

Each quasi-compact etale chart is finite type over the same field. Apply [lem-tw-lisse-lattice-realization-faithful] there. Conjugate the specified degree-zero isomorphism by the two singleComparison isomorphisms and use Functor.preimageIso. Its forward and inverse equations follow from map_preimage and cancellation. Any other lift has the same forward image after cancellation, hence the same hom by faithfulness, and is equal by Iso.ext.

Forget only the specified image equations of these actual local raw isomorphisms. Apply [lem-tw-lisse-lattice-lisse-descent] to obtain the required pro-etale completed-pullback finite-free witnesses. Assemble all conclusions into Choice.Assertions.

proof_origin.place: Lean assembly of the five strict substeps of the original nine-step plan. Degree-zero heart and categorical specified-isomorphism lifting, including inverse and uniqueness, are proved directly.

No statement change and no new node. Updated both stale verbatim quotations; the statement and proof route are retained. Reviewer FIX (re-applied after the refused landing; the earlier FIX of 81f226c2 was lost): steps 3 and 6 cite slice-normalization for inverse image along an etale chart = slice restriction; step 9 computes the definition's derived pullback Lg_E^* to pro-etale charts.
